sections.title: Workstream progress
sections.sql: select acquisition,workstream,name,owner,due_date,status,blockers,days_overdue from task_board order by acquisition,due_date

name: value
title: Monthly benefit evidence
subtitle: Costs reduce net benefit. Reported and accepted amounts are separate.

sections.title: Period totals
sections.sql: select acquisition,currency,period,planned_net_cents,reported_net_cents,accepted_net_cents,variance_cents,missing_actuals,held_actuals from benefit_summary order by acquisition,period

sections.title: Evidence review
sections.sql: select acquisition,initiative,currency,period,actual_cents,evidence,reviewed_by,accepted from benefit_detail order by acquisition,period,initiative

sections.title: Open risks
sections.sql: select a.name as acquisition,r.name,r.owner,r.severity,r.due_date from risks r join acquisitions a on a.id=r.acquisition_id where r.status='open' order by r.due_date

sections.title: Privacy review evidence
sections.sql: select * from compliance_attention order by acquisition,rule
